observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: A bright, white-background studio, likely for an instructional video.
observation.dancers: Two dancers: one man and one woman.
observation.formation_and_space: Side-by-side, facing the camera, moving in unison.
observation.posture: Upright, relaxed, with knees slightly bent.
observation.footwork: A repeating pattern of four steps to the right, four to the left, four back, and a step-touch-step-kick sequence. The steps are rhythmic and on the beat.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms move naturally with the body, often swinging or gesturing to the side in time with the steps.
observation.hips_and_torso: Minimal torso movement, with slight hip swaying during the side steps.
observation.partnering: None; they dance side-by-side without contact.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Includes a step-touch and a kick, with occasional bending to touch the floor.
observation.costume_and_props: Casual, modern clothing: the man wears a green V-neck sweater and dark pants; the woman wears a black tank top and dark, patterned pants.
observation.cannot_infer: The video is an instructional demonstration, so the footwork is clear, but the camera cuts and the studio setting make it difficult to see the full range of motion or the weight transfer in detail.

signature_moments.what: Four steps to the right, with the left foot tapping behind the right on the fourth beat.
Four steps to the left, with the right foot tapping behind the left on the fourth beat.
Four steps backward, with the right foot tapping in front of the left on the fourth beat.
A step-touch to the front, followed by a step-touch to the back.
A step-kick sequence, where the foot that was in front steps and the foot that was in back kicks.
A variation where the dancers bend down to touch the floor with their hands.
